invariants.rationale: Based on typical timer usage, flingTimer should not be negative at method entry.
flingTimer is likely initialized to 0 or set to positive values; this expresses the non-negativity in another way.
If isFlinging() returns true, then flingTimer must be greater than 0 by the method's return statement.
The method always returns (flingTimer > 0), capturing equivalence.
flingTimer, being an int, cannot exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE.
